verdict.rationale: Featurebase's own site states that changelogs can be served from a standalone page on a custom domain and fully branded, which covers every element of the story. The evidence is only a repeated marketing line, with no in-depth setup documentation. Missing for 10: detailed docs on custom-domain setup (DNS/SSL) and branding options, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can serve a fully branded public changelog page on a custom domain
